components.name: Ink button
components.description: The main action on a sheet.
components.css: .ds-ink-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #1d2a2f; color: #fff; font: 700 15px/1 Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ink-btn:hover { background: #2f4249; } .ds-ink-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d2a2f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper button
components.css: .ds-paper-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #1d2a2f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1d2a2f; font: 700 15px/1 Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-paper-btn:hover { background: #cfe2ea; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #1d2a2f; font: 700 14px Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(29 54 66 / 0.22); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tag:hover { background: #cfe2ea; } .ds-tag[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #1d2a2f; color: #fff; }

components.name: Pinned sheet
components.description: White paper pinned to the board, slightly tilted.
components.html:
Say hi

I'd love to hear from you.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; max-width: 320px; padding: 34px; background: #fff; color: #1d2a2f; transform: rotate(-0.8deg); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgb(29 54 66 / 0.22), 0 2px 3px rgb(29 54 66 / 0.2); font: 400 16px/1.5 Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; } .ds-pin { position: absolute; top: -9px; left: 50%; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: -10px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7) 0 18%, transparent 20%), #e2402f; box-shadow: 1px 4px 4px rgb(20 40 50 / 0.4); }

components.name: Route sign
components.description: Green guide sign with towns and a place-colour panel.
components.css: .ds-sign { position: relative; width: 240px; padding: 10px 10px 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #0b6b3a; color: #fff; font: 800 17px Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sign::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border: 2.5px solid #fff; border-radius: 7px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-sign-head { padding: 10px 8px; font-size: 19px; } .ds-sign-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 8px; } .ds-sign-panel { margin: 6px -6px 0; padding: 10px 12px 8px; border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px; background: #f6d44a; color: #1d2a2f; font-size: 15px; text-align: center; transform: translateY(-4px); }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Visible label above, ink border, yellow focus ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-email">Your email</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-email" type="email">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font: 800 16px Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d2a2f; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2px solid #1d2a2f; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #1d2a2f; font: 400 17px/1.4 Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6d44a; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: Groups and events are paper pinned to a pale blue fabric board, coloured by where they happen; the routes are real green highway signs.
keyCharacteristics: Blue fabric ground, white paper, soft shadows, pushpins, small tilts
Colour means place; categories are white tags
Real highway signs and shields, Overpass throughout
Sentence case, no italics, no all caps

rules.name: The Colour Means Place Rule
rules.body: Route colours mark where something happens and nothing else.

rules.name: The Ink On Colour Rule
rules.body: Text on a place colour is always ink.

rules.name: The No Italics Rule
rules.body: Nothing is italic; emphasis is weight or the marker stripe.

rules.name: The Pins Are For Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper is pinned and tilted; signs and controls never are.

dos: Do colour things by where they happen, using the five route colours.
Do put text on place colours in ink.
Do pin or tape paper and give it a small tilt.
Do keep every target at least 44px.
donts: Don't use italics, all caps or a second typeface.
Don't put pushpins on signs or controls.
Don't add contact details for groups or subscribers.
